name: 1Zpresso K-Ultra
details: External numbered dial, 100 clicks per rotation, 20 microns per click (dial reading = clicks ÷ 10). All-rounder, espresso-capable.

grindRanges.scale: clicks from zero (burrs closed); dial number = clicks ÷ 10

notes.aeropress: 1Zpresso groups AeroPress, moka pot and drip coffee maker (5–7).

rangeInfo.note: 1Zpresso “Kultra Grind Setting Reference” chart (Kultra-Grind-Setting-Reference-20221031.jpg on that page), in dial points: Turkish 2–3.5, espresso 3–4.5, AeroPress/moka/drip coffee maker 5–7, siphon/pour over 8–9, French press 9–10.
